summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 13/13 reference-tree + smoke tests passing (GET/PUT /api/admin/reference-tree, validation rejection cases, public reflection, per-person relation_categories PUT, regression smoke). Frontend: verified OTP help GIF gating + aspect ratio, admin Reference Tree editor (data-testids, add child enables save, detail panel relation-category add chip), and source-level verification of ReferenceTreePicker overlay/no-from-line + sticky nav on Step 2 only. ReferenceTreePicker live overlay click test was skipped because Step 2 requires verified OTP; covered via static source review and DOM testid verification.

design_issues.screen: AdminDashboard - RefRelationStatsBlock (NOT introduced in this iteration)
issues: Console hydration warning: <button> nested inside <button> at AdminDashboard.js:519/527 (ref-stat row contains nested action buttons). Pre-existing; flagged for cleanup but unrelated to iter-2 changes.

action_items: Optional: in ReferencePersonManager Discard handler, ensure pending tree changes are reverted even when user dismisses confirm() — observed save button remained enabled after discard in headless test (likely because window.confirm was not auto-accepted). Not a functional bug; verify in real browser. Could also expose a no-confirm code path or auto-no-op when there is nothing dirty.
Optional cleanup: fix nested-<button> hydration warning in AdminDashboard RefRelationStatsBlock (lines ~519/527) — pre-existing, not introduced in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_family_tree() correctly enforces single root, unique ids, valid parents, non-empty names, and cycles via walk-to-root. Good.

PUT /api/admin/reference-tree re-syncs reference_persons collection idempotently (upsert + delete-not-in-payload), preserving rank/description/relation_categories on existing nodes via $setOnInsert. Good design.
ReferenceTreePicker.jsx correctly removes 'From X' / 'के यहाँ से' lines from search results (line 292) and selected card (line 331). Trajectory line preserved.

RegisterPage.js: GIF only mounted inside otp_sent block (line 424) with class 'w-full max-w-[320px] h-auto' (no inline aspectRatio); enter_mobile block (line 374) has no GIF. Verified via Playwright DOM probe.
Step 2 sticky nav block is data-testid='form-nav-sticky' with classes 'sticky bottom-0 ... z-20'; other steps use 'form-nav' non-sticky.
Tree node CSS (.rd3-node-name) is unified with font-weight:500 + no stroke across root/lineage/selected/muted variants — matches request to remove bold/text-border for non-leaf nodes.
server.py is 6025 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules in future iteration (auth, registrations, admin, reference, whatsapp). Pre-existing, not introduced here.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on items independently testable (GIF gating + admin tree editor + detail panel). ReferenceTreePicker live overlay/click validated via source review + DOM testid presence (cannot reach live Step 2 without real OTP).
